manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Stack the three the smooth bowl with glossy finish one above the other.

Task description: Stack the three glossy blue bowls scattered on the left side of the table. Their top-to-bottom order does not matter.

Success criteria: Stack the three bowls in one pile with adjacent bodies approximately aligned horizontally. The bottom bowl must be close to the table, and the middle and top bowls at low, compact nesting heights. Both grippers must be open and release the bowls.

## Execution tips

- Choose a rim-wall section with ample surrounding space and grip it with one finger inside and one outside. Contact the wall below the rim with the pads and adjust the opening to wall thickness and clearance, reducing the risk of the smooth rim slipping from the fingertips.
- Before closing, confirm the fingers are actually on opposite sides of the bowl wall rather than merely overlapping in the image. A small test lift can reveal slipping and prevent transporting an insecure grasp.
- Keep the bowl opening facing up during transport. Before moving laterally, lift its base and the gripper fingers above nearby bowl rims, and reorient where there is room to avoid brushing other bowls at a low height.
- As the upper bowl approaches the lower, correct small lateral offsets before lowering slowly. If one rim side contacts or catches, lift slightly and realign instead of pressing farther and tilting or sliding the lower bowl.
- During lowering, watch clearance between the outer finger and lower bowl rim, avoiding the gap between the bowls. Once the upper bowl is supported, open slowly and withdraw upward to reduce dropping it or lifting bowls already stacked.
